{{Quote|The main Gormak invasion force has been sighted. They've committed their forces to capturing a large Voss dam across the marches. This whole region was once covered by flood waters, driving the Gormak out. Now I fear they've discovered the Evuk-Nosk near the dam.|[[Halykus]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''Err-Ka Dam''' was a dam built on the eastern edge of the [[Pelath-Ri Marches]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Built by the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]] to hold back the water that once covered the Pelath-Ri Marches, the dam was captured by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Galactic War]], and the Gormak sought the ''[[Evuk-Nosk]]'' in the area.
